description: This file defines the class PdfFontProgram, representing a base class for PDF font objects within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for creating font files and adding them to font descriptors, handling font subset creation, compression, and stream creation.

classes.name: PdfFontProgram
classes.description: Represents the base class of a PDF font, providing mechanisms to create and integrate font files into a PDF document.

methods.name: CreateFontFileAndAddToDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a font file from a font subset, optionally compresses it, and adds it to the corresponding font descriptor in a PDF document.
